1477-5267-7924.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing a Clue.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

4222-6006-8039.description:
Activate Spireside Infiltrator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Spireside Infiltrator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Spireside Infiltrator.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2438-6972-7936.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2034-7084-7889.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1430-1619-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1619-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Mirror Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1619-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7509.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2292-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

618-4456-7445-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Dirgur Focusmage // Braingeyser.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1818-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-4186-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

240-1849-5470-6798.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-4460-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

5078-5231-6089-7028.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Diving Top and then discard any card that isn't Sensei's Divining Top.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

57-2751-3480-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-2751-3480-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3188-3490-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-3490-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1605-4613-4968-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Gratuitous Violence.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

5299-5400-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Synth Infiltrator
5299-5400-5466.description:
Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Synth Infiltrator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Synth Infiltrator's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Synth Infiltrator's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Synth Infiltrator's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

509-1267-3933-5143.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-3933-5143.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-3933-5143.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

4484-4871-5147-5643-6710.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-5147-5643-6710.notablePrerequisites: There are two cards exiled by The Kenriths' Royal Funeral.
4484-4871-5147-5643-6710.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5147-5643-6710.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1491-2033-4565-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2033-4565-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2033-4565-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

488-1482-1492-2895-4986.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Jeweled Lotus or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1482-1492-2895-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2351-4639-6236.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Bramblesnap by tapping a blue creature you control except Unctus.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Bramblesnap ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2239-4558-5686.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least nine tapped lands.
2091-2239-4558-5686.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature that is a Gnome and/or Artificer

2527-3967-4073-4917--75.notablePrerequisites:
Jan Jansen and the additional Gnome or Artificer do not have a +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
2527-3967-4073-4917--75.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature you control except the Gnome or Artificer.
Jan Jansen triggers, causing it and creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jan Jansen.
When Jan Jansen dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Gnome or Artificer.
When the Gnome or Artificer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Jan Jansen and the other Gnome or Artificer, giving a creature -2/-2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

1636-4050-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4050-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1808-2511-2837.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1808-2511-2837.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3368-5959.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional sorcery
3368-5959.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
You have a sorcery card in hand.
3368-5959.description:
Cast the additional sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Alania triggers; choose not to have an opponent draw a card.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting the additional sorcery.
Alania triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card and you to copy Reiterate, with the copy targeting the original Reiterate.
Resolve the copy of Reiterate, copying the original Reiterate, with the copy targeting the original Reiterate.
Repeat step 5.

275-3388-5745.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
275-3388-5745.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Staff of Eden.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Morrite of the Frost's enters-the-battlefield ability and Transplant Theorist trigger.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Staff of Eden.
Repeat from step 2.

647-1069-2457-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
647-1069-2457-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

215-2557-4231-5444.description:
Cast Carnage Interpreter by paying {1}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Carnage Interpreter enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight Clue, Food and Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B/R}{B/R}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Carnage Interpreter to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1061-1781-2043.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
1061-1781-2043.description:
Activate Thran Forge by paying {2}, causing Timestream Navigator to get +1/+0 and become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator that is a 1/1 Soldier creature.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1017-1143-4772-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Diviner's Wand attached to Cryptic Trilobite.
1017-1143-4772-4929.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by paying {4}, causing you to draw a card.
Cryptic Trilobite and Wizard Class trigger.
Resolve the Cryptic Trilobite trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Wizard Class trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat

215-864-1311-2436.notablePrerequisites:
Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn has a power of at least seven.
215-864-1311-2436.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Cast Mobilize by paying {G}, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Mobilize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2067-4688.notablePrerequisites: Your life total plus the number of creatures you control is equal to or greater than twenty.
2067-4688.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

57-1849-2491-4846.notablePrerequisites: At least {3}{R} from sources that ETB untapped.
57-1849-2491-4846.description:
Cast Heart-Piercer Manticore.
When it ETBs, its trigger goes onto the stack.
In response to the trigger, activate Feldon's ability, making a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
The token copy of Worldgorger Dragon ETBs, exiling all permanents you control.
Resolve the Heart-Piercer Manticore trigger, sacrificing the token copy of Worldgorger Dragon and dealing 7 damage to any target.
The token Worldgorger Dragon's LTB triggers, returning all permanents you control to the battlefield.
Repeat for infinite damage.
